title: Review start and the review pack

confirmations.text:
Terms:

- **Review folder**: `.stapel/scratch/review/<KEY>-r<N>/`, with `<KEY>` the name of the ticket's folder
  under `.stapel/tickets/`; ignored by git.
- **Tags**: the backtick spans equal to `security`, `guard`, `data`, `migration` or `interface` in the
  paragraph of the Frame that starts with `**Risk tags:**`, up to the next blank line or the next line that starts with `#` or `**`.
- **Light**: the Plan's `Route:` line starts with `light` (`next::is_light`).
- **Code-review round** of a ticket: the highest of the whole rounds (STP-23) of the finding records with
  stage `code-review` in `findings.jsonl` and the rounds whose review folder holds `pack.md`; 0 when there
  is none.
- **Patch finding**: a finding record with stage `code-review` and whole round 1 whose current state
  (STP-23) has the fate `patch` and is not false.

| № | Criterion | Test |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | IF `stapel review start KEY --round N` names an unknown ticket, a closed ticket or a round other than 1 or 2, or the tree has uncommitted changes (as `next` counts them) THEN exit 2 with the text of the cases table and nothing written; a legacy (STP-1) ticket, a missing base or a base not on the first-parent history of HEAD exit 1; the first case in the table's order wins. | `review::refuses_tickets`, `review::refuses_a_dirty_tree`, `review::refuses_bad_rounds`, `review::refuses_a_bad_base`, `review::refusal_order`, `review::refusal_order_of_the_later_cases`, `review::refusals_write_nothing` |
| AC-2 | IF `--round 2` runs while the ticket has no finding record with stage `code-review` and whole round 1 THEN exit 2 with `stapel: round 2 needs the code review findings of round 1 in .stapel/tickets/<KEY>/findings.jsonl` and nothing written. | `review::round_two_needs_round_one` |
| AC-3 | WHEN `review start` runs THE review folder is removed if present and gets `tree/`, the files of HEAD as a checkout with `core.autocrlf=false` writes them (the `.gitattributes` of HEAD apply), with their modes and no `.git`, while the repository's index, working tree and refs stay unchanged; `.stapel/scratch/review/.gitignore` holds `*` so that the copies never make the tree dirty, and `.stapel/scratch/review/.ignore` holds `!*` so that search tools that read `.ignore` (ripgrep) still search them. | `review::copies_head`, `review::rerun_replaces_the_copy`, `review::copy_keeps_the_index`, `review::copy_ignores_autocrlf`, `review::copy_needs_no_tar`, `review::copy_follows_attributes`, `review::copy_keeps_plain_modes`, `review::copy_is_searchable` |
| AC-4 | WHEN `review start` runs THE review folder gets `diff.patch`, the output of `git -c core.quotepath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --find-renames --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/ base..HEAD`, and `pack.md` written last: the key, round, base and HEAD commits, the paths of the copy, the ticket in the copy and `diff.patch`, the stat of the same diff with `--stat=120 --stat-graph-width=20`, the whole Spec section as written (its Terms, criteria, tables and Guarantees) and the three review checks of decision 0002, as the golden file of round 1. | `review::pack_of_round_one`, `review::diff_file`, `review::pack_stat_and_order` |
| AC-5 | WHEN `--round 2` runs THE pack also lists every patch finding of the working tree's `findings.jsonl` as `- <id> (<current severity>): <claim>` in file order, with each line break of the claim written as a space, or `- none`, as the golden file of round 2. | `review::pack_of_round_two`, `review::pack_flattens_a_claim` |
| AC-6 | WHEN `review start` succeeds THE output is `copy: <folder>tree (HEAD <12 hex>)`, `pack: <folder>pack.md`, then one line `reviewer: <agent>, model <model> (role <role>)` per reviewer: for a light ticket or one without tags only `stapel-reviewer` (role `reviewer`); for a tagged one also `stapel-reviewer` (role `external`) and `stapel-drift` (role `drift`) followed by `, on the whole ticket`; a role absent from `[models]` prints `no model` for `model <model>`. | `review::reviewers_by_route_and_tags`, `review::reviewer_without_a_model`, `review::tags_paragraph_ends` |
| AC-7 | WHEN `next` would give `code-review` and the code-review round is 0 THE target is the command `stapel review start <KEY> --round 1`; when it is 1 and a patch finding exists, `stapel review start <KEY> --round 2`; otherwise the ticket path, as before. | `review::next_names_round_one`, `review::next_names_round_two`, `review::next_after_the_rounds`, `review::next_after_a_clean_round`, `review::next_counts_only_real_rounds` |
| AC-8 | WHEN `init` writes the skill and the reviewer agent THE skill holds a line that starts ``- `code-review`:`` and holds `stapel review start KEY --round N`, `give every reviewer it prints the path of pack.md` and `before round 2, add a fix step to the Plan for each finding with the fate patch`, and no longer holds ``a copy (`git archive`)``; the reviewer body holds `Read pack.md first; read files only in the review folder it names.` and no longer holds `git archive`. | `init_process::skill_text_names_the_review_pack` |
| AC-9 | WHEN `review start` runs THE folders directly under `.stapel/scratch/review/` named `<KEY>-r<n>`, with `<n>` a whole number, of the same ticket and another round or of a closed ticket are removed without following symlinks; other open tickets' folders and other names stay. | `review::removes_old_copies`, `review::removes_old_copies_edges` |
| AC-10 | IF the ticket has no Spec section, two of them, or a Spec without an `AC-<n>` row THEN `review start` exits 2 with `stapel: the Spec of <KEY> has no criteria; a review pack needs them` and nothing written. | `review::refuses_a_ticket_without_criteria` |
| AC-11 | WHEN `init` writes the drift agent THE body holds `When the orchestrator gives you a pack.md instead of a step, you review the whole ticket` and a JSON line with `"stage":"code-review"`, and keeps the step-drift line of STP-23; its first paragraph names both inputs, a step's diff or a `pack.md`, and no longer holds `do not look for more context`. | `init_process::drift_text_reviews_the_whole_ticket` |

Cases table of the refusals, in the order they are checked (exit 2 unless named):

| Case | Text after `stapel: ` |
|---|---|
| round not a number | the clap usage error, exit 2 |
| unknown key | `no ticket <KEY> in .stapel/tickets` (as `resolve`) |
| legacy, exit 1 | `ticket <KEY> is in the STP-1 format; it has no review pack` |
| closed | `ticket <KEY> is closed; it has no review round` |
| round 0, 3 or more | `--round must be 1 or 2; after round 2 the person decides` |
| dirty tree | `uncommitted changes: <first five paths>; commit them before a review round` |
| no base, exit 1 | `state.json of <KEY> has no base commit` |
| bad base, exit 1 | the text of `build_inputs::check_base` |
| round 2 without round 1 | the text of AC-2 |
| no criteria | the text of AC-10 |

### Guarantees

- **Promised:** the Frame's promise, by AC-1 to AC-11; outside `.stapel/scratch/review/` `review start`
  writes nothing; `pack.md` is written last, so a folder without it is incomplete; the other actions of `next` and their order are unchanged.
- **Not promised:** the Frame's list; the copy's own `findings.jsonl` is that of HEAD and may be older
  than the working tree's; the round 2 refusal reads legacy records like new ones and skips damaged
  lines, as `next` does (D1-5); a temporary `index` left in the round folder when git fails (D1F-2); a
  file or file symlink named like a round folder is removed as well (D1C-1); a failed removal of an old
  copy stops `review start` with exit 1, and an unreadable `review/` folder is skipped (D1C-2); a
  `**Risk tags:**` line below the Frame is read when the Frame has none (D3-2); a missing or doubled Plan
  or Description reads as full and untagged (D3-4); diff settings other than those AC-4 overrides, such as
  `diff.algorithm`, `diff.context` and `diff.orderFile` (R-4); a dangling symlink, a plain file or a
  `<KEY>-r0<N>` name in place of the current round's folder (R-5, E-8); review folders of a ticket whose
  folder is gone, legacy or unreadable (E-6); an unreadable `state.json` exits 1 with its reason (DR-1); submodules (a gitlink gives no files); symlinks in
  HEAD that point outside the copy; `.gitattributes` `export-ignore` (the copy is a checkout, not an
  archive); a Claude Code allow rule for `review start`; two `review start` runs at once.

### Facts

- F-0: prior art: the reviewer prompts of STP-22 and STP-23 under `.stapel/scratch/`, the agent text
  `crates/stapel-cli/assets/agents/reviewer.md`; no code runs `git archive` or reads a tar, and
  `stapel-cli` has no tar dependency.
- F-1: `tickets::resolve` gives the key and status; `build_inputs::check_base` checks the base;
  `worktree::dirty_paths` lists dirty paths without ignored and machine files.
- F-2: `next::is_light` reads the route; risk tags are read only by `tests/ticket_drift.rs`, from the first
  line; the AC rows are read by private functions of `brief.rs` (`row_number`, `cells`).
- F-3: `triage::state_of` and `triage::whole_round` give the current state and round of a finding.
- F-4: `next::after_the_steps` gives `code-review` with the ticket path; five tests of `tests/next.rs`
  assert that path (`uncommitted_changes_before_the_check`, `run_check_after_the_steps`,
  `code_review_then_summary`, `review_and_summary_edges`, `index_untouched`).

### Decisions (before the build)

- The new module `crates/stapel-cli/src/review.rs` holds `start`; `crates/stapel-core/src/review.rs` holds the
  pure parts: the tags of a Frame, the reviewer list, the patch findings, the pack text and the round that
  `next` names.
- The copy: `git -c core.autocrlf=false read-tree HEAD` with `GIT_INDEX_FILE` set to `<folder>index`, then
  `git checkout-index -a --prefix=<folder>tree/` with the same variable, then the index file is removed.
- `diff.patch` and the stat: the commands of AC-4; `checkout-index` also runs with `-c core.autocrlf=false`.
- `review start` writes `.stapel/scratch/review/.gitignore` (`*`) before the copy (the human, 2026-10-28,
  B-4).
- Step 1 GREEN: a command that passes every refusal exits 0 and prints and writes nothing; steps 1b to 3
  replace this.
- `brief.rs` makes `row_number` and `cells` public for the criteria rows.
- `next::Facts` gets the code-review round and whether a patch finding exists, computed by the CLI `next`
  from the records it already reads.
- Old tests: in the RED of step 4, the five tests of F-4 change their expected `code-review` line to the
  command, so that they fail at the RED.

### Decisions (as built)

- `crates/stapel-cli/src/review.rs` checks the refusals in the order of the cases table; a legacy
  `state.json` that also has `closed` reads as legacy, so legacy wins (step 1d).
- `copy_head` runs `git -c core.autocrlf=false read-tree HEAD` and `checkout-index -a --prefix` with
  `GIT_INDEX_FILE=<folder>index`, removes that file, and writes `.stapel/scratch/review/.gitignore` (`*`)
  (step 1f, replacing the `git archive | tar` of step 1b, B-2) and `.stapel/scratch/review/.ignore`
  (`!*`) (step 6, R-1).
- `remove_old_copies` runs before the copy; it takes names `<KEY>-r<digits>`, removes a symlink itself and
  never follows it (step 1c).
- `crates/stapel-core/src/review.rs` holds `criteria`, `patch_findings`, `pack_text`, `frame_tags`,
  `reviewers`, `finding_round` and `next_round`; `brief.rs` makes `cells` and `row_number` public.
- `pack.md`: a title `# Review pack <KEY>, round <N>`, list items for the ticket, round, base and head,
  the repository-relative paths, the stat in a code fence, the Spec section as written (step 8; step 2
  wrote one line per AC row), the round 2 list with the claims' line breaks as spaces (step 6), then the
  three checks; the golden files hold the exact text.
- The AC-10 refusal reads `ticket.md` after the round 2 check and before the old copies are removed; a
  comment in `review.rs` holds the full AC-10 text with its `stapel: ` prefix, because `Fail` adds the
  prefix at print time and the ticket lint looks for the quoted line (step 2c).
- `frame_tags` ends the tags paragraph at a blank line or a line that starts with `#` or `**` (step 3).
- `next::Facts` gets `review_round` and `patch_finding`; the CLI `next` computes the round from the
  records and from `pack_round`, which counts `<KEY>-r<N>` folders holding `pack.md` with `N` written
  without leading zeros, while the cleanup of AC-9 also removes `r02` (step 4).

| Criterion | Test |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `review::refuses_tickets`, `review::refuses_a_dirty_tree`, `review::refuses_bad_rounds`, `review::refuses_a_bad_base`, `review::refusal_order`, `review::refusal_order_of_the_later_cases`, `review::refusals_write_nothing` |
| AC-2 | `review::round_two_needs_round_one` |
| AC-3 | `review::copies_head`, `review::rerun_replaces_the_copy`, `review::copy_keeps_the_index`, `review::copy_ignores_autocrlf`, `review::copy_needs_no_tar`, `review::copy_follows_attributes`, `review::copy_keeps_plain_modes`, `review::copy_is_searchable` |
| AC-4 | `review::pack_of_round_one`, `review::diff_file`, `review::pack_stat_and_order` |
| AC-5 | `review::pack_of_round_two`, `review::pack_flattens_a_claim` |
| AC-6 | `review::reviewers_by_route_and_tags`, `review::reviewer_without_a_model`, `review::tags_paragraph_ends` |
| AC-7 | `review::next_names_round_one`, `review::next_names_round_two`, `review::next_after_the_rounds`, `review::next_after_a_clean_round`, `review::next_counts_only_real_rounds` |
| AC-8 | `init_process::skill_text_names_the_review_pack` |
| AC-9 | `review::removes_old_copies`, `review::removes_old_copies_edges` |
| AC-10 | `review::refuses_a_ticket_without_criteria` |
| AC-11 | `init_process::drift_text_reviews_the_whole_ticket` |

Route: full (tag `interface`), auto.

1. `stapel review start KEY --round N` with its refusals (AC-1, AC-2; tests `review::refuses_tickets`,
   `review::refuses_a_dirty_tree`, `review::refuses_bad_rounds`, `review::refuses_a_bad_base`,
   `review::round_two_needs_round_one`, `review::refusal_order`); a success is the stub of Design. Must not
   change: the other commands.
1d. Fix after the drift review of step 1 (D1-1 to D1-4, D1-6; AC-1; tests `review::refuses_tickets`,
   `review::refuses_a_dirty_tree`, `review::refuses_bad_rounds`, `review::refuses_a_bad_base`,
   `review::refusal_order`): the RED makes these tests assert the exact text and exit code of the Spec's
   refusal cases table (under AC-9; not in the brief) in its order; seven dirty paths name five; a base off
   the first-parent history exits 1; `common::snapshot` unchanged. The GREEN changes
   `crates/stapel-cli/src/review.rs` only.
1e. Coverage after the drift review of step 1d (D1D-1; AC-1): new `#[test]` function
   `review::refusal_order_of_the_later_cases`. Tests only, each helper nested inside its function, no
   `cargo fmt`; a test that fails is an `intent_gap`.
1b. The copy of HEAD (AC-3; tests `review::copies_head`, `review::rerun_replaces_the_copy`,
   `review::copy_keeps_the_index`, `review::copy_ignores_autocrlf`). Must not change: the repository's
   index, working tree and refs; step 1.
1f. Fix after step 1b (B-2 to B-4; AC-3; tests `review::copy_needs_no_tar`,
   `review::copy_keeps_the_index`): the copy by a temporary index and `checkout-index` as Design says, not
   `git archive | tar`; one `.gitignore` in `.stapel/scratch/review/`; output only through `out.rs`
   (`closed_pipe::no_print_macros_outside_out`). The RED adds `review::copy_needs_no_tar` and changes
   `review::copy_keeps_the_index` so that both fail there. Must not change: steps 1 to 1e.
1c. Old copies removed (AC-9; test `review::removes_old_copies`). Must not change: steps 1 and 1b.
1g. Coverage after the drift reviews of steps 1f and 1c (D1F-1, D1F-3, D1C-3; AC-3, AC-9): new `#[test]`
   functions `review::copy_follows_attributes`, `review::copy_keeps_plain_modes`,
   `review::removes_old_copies_edges`. Tests only, each helper nested inside its function, no `cargo fmt`;
   a test that fails is an `intent_gap`.
2. `pack.md` and `diff.patch` (AC-4, AC-5; tests `review::pack_of_round_one`, `review::diff_file`,
   `review::pack_of_round_two`); the golden files come with the RED. Must not change: steps 1 to 1c; the output of
   `brief`.
3. The reviewer lines (AC-6; tests `review::reviewers_by_route_and_tags`,
   `review::reviewer_without_a_model`). Must not change: steps 1 and 2.
2b. Coverage after the drift review of step 2 (D2-3, D2-4; AC-4, AC-5): new `#[test]` function
   `review::pack_stat_and_order`. Tests only, each helper nested inside its function, no `cargo fmt`; a
   test that fails is an `intent_gap`.
2c. A ticket without criteria refused (AC-10, D2-2; test `review::refuses_a_ticket_without_criteria`),
   checked after the other refusals of the cases table. Must not change: steps 1 to 3.
3b. Coverage after the drift review of step 3 (D3-1, D3-3; AC-6): new `#[test]` function
   `review::tags_paragraph_ends`. Tests only, each helper nested inside its function, no `cargo fmt`; a
   test that fails is an `intent_gap`.
4. The `code-review` target of `next` (AC-7; tests `review::next_names_round_one`,
   `review::next_names_round_two`, `review::next_after_the_rounds`, `review::next_after_a_clean_round`); the old tests as in Design. Must not
   change: the other actions of `next` and their order.
4b. Coverage after the drift review of step 4 (D4-1, D4-2; AC-7): new `#[test]` function
   `review::next_counts_only_real_rounds`. Tests only, each helper nested inside its function, no
   `cargo fmt`; a test that fails is an `intent_gap`.
5. The skill and reviewer texts (AC-8; test `init_process::skill_text_names_the_review_pack`):
   `crates/stapel-cli/assets/skill.md` and `assets/agents/reviewer.md`; the GREEN runs the built
   `stapel init` here so that `init_process::this_repository_has_the_current_files` holds. Must not change:
   the other sentences that `init_process` tests.

6. Fixes after code review round 1 (R-1, R-3, DR-1, E-3; AC-3, AC-5; tests `review::copy_is_searchable`,
   `review::pack_flattens_a_claim`): `review start` writes `.stapel/scratch/review/.ignore`; a claim's
   line breaks become spaces in the pack; the module comment of `crates/stapel-cli/src/review.rs` says what
   the command does now. Must not change: the other tests.
6b. Coverage after code review round 1 (E-4; AC-1, AC-2): new `#[test]` function
   `review::refusals_write_nothing`. Tests only, each helper nested inside its function, no `cargo fmt`;
   a test that fails is an `intent_gap`.
7. Texts after code review round 1 (R-2, E-1, E-2, E-7; AC-8, AC-11; tests
   `init_process::skill_text_names_the_review_pack`, `init_process::drift_text_reviews_the_whole_ticket`):
   the RED changes the first test to the new AC-8 sentences, so that it fails there, and adds the second;
   the GREEN changes `assets/skill.md`, `assets/agents/reviewer.md` and `assets/agents/drift.md` and runs the
   built `stapel init` here. Must not change: the other sentences that `init_process` tests.

8. The whole Spec in the pack (AC-4; tests `review::pack_of_round_one`, `review::pack_of_round_two`): the
   RED changes the golden files `crates/stapel-cli/tests/golden/review_pack_r1.md` and `review_pack_r2.md`
   (and the fixture Spec, if it lacks Terms or Guarantees) so that both tests fail there; the GREEN writes
   the Spec section as written in place of the criteria lines. Must not change: the other tests.
9. Texts after code review round 2 (R2-1, E2-3, E2-4; AC-11; test
   `init_process::drift_text_reviews_the_whole_ticket`): the RED makes the test assert the new first
   paragraph, so that it fails there; the GREEN changes `assets/agents/drift.md`, its front-matter
   description and the module comment of `crates/stapel-cli/src/review.rs`, and runs the built `stapel init`
   here. Must not change: the other sentences that `init_process` tests.
